rules.title: Server disconnected the client
rules.advice: The server kicked you, usually because of a mismatch between your client mods and the server's. Match your modlist and versions exactly, or join with a vanilla client to verify connectivity.

rules.title: Microsoft / Mojang session expired
patterns: Failed to login: Invalid session token
rules.advice: Your auth token has expired. Open **Accounts** and re-sign-in to your Microsoft account. If you use a third-party auth provider (Drasl, Ely.by) make sure its plugin is still enabled and its server is reachable.

rules.title: Asset download failed
rules.advice: MeshMC couldn't reach one of Minecraft's asset CDNs. Check your network connection or proxy. Some corporate firewalls block `resources.download.minecraft.net` and `libraries.minecraft.net` — add those to the allow-list.
